text:
sophie_support: Heads-up: acme reported a change in reply style after we rolled rwd-llm-4.3.1 yesterday. They say responses feel more direct and sometimes drop a closing sentence. Pasting their repro and examples. cc @eli_oncall @maya_research

acme_corp_ops: Repro here. We call /v1/chat/completions with a system prompt + user prompt. Old model (pinned to rwd-llm-4.2.9) returned a slightly warmer sign-off. New model (rwd-llm-4.3.1) is shorter. Example:

```bash
# request (same for both)
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model":"rwd-llm-4.3.1",
  "messages":[
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that is polite and explains steps."},
    {"role":"user","content":"How do I rotate my API key without downtime?"}
  ]
}
```

OLD (4.2.9):
```
Thanks for the question — rotating your API key can be done safely. First, create a new key. Then update your instances one at a time and verify. Finally, revoke the old key. Let me know if you want a checklist.
```

NEW (4.3.1):
```
Create a new key, update instances, revoke old key.
```

acme_corp_ops: Token counts: prompt ~78, OLD output ~62 tokens, NEW output ~19 tokens. No prompt template changes on our side.

sophie_support: Can you paste the full request/headers and any routing or tenant id? Also did you pin model per-route or use the default rollout?

acme_corp_ops: We use tenant acme-01, route `chat.standard`. Model was switched globally by the rollout. Full request log (sanitized):

```json
{
  "tenant": "acme-01",
  "route": "chat.standard",
  "model": "rwd-llm-4.3.1",
  "user_id": "ops-123",
  "prompt_tokens": 78,
  "response_tokens": 19
}
```

deploy-bot: rollout rwd-llm-4.3.1 -> all regions completed 2026-03-15T02:12:04Z

eli_oncall: I checked infra metrics — no 5xxs or throttles. Latency stable. No errors in the request path. Tagging @maya_research to investigate model-level changes.

maya_research: Quick follow-up: release notes show we adjusted some safety defaults and removed the 'verbosity_boost' system augmentation to cut hallucination. That could explain shorter outputs. I'll run a micro-eval comparing 4.2.9 vs 4.3.1 with the exact prompt.

maya_research: Ran eval: confirmed median response length dropped ~34% and stylistic markers (hedging, sign-offs) decreased significantly. Hypothesis: system-level augmentation removal changed implicit politeness/verbosity. 

acme_corp_ops: This impacted customer UX — one support ticket escalated. Can we get a mitigation? Prefer a per-tenant toggle to restore previous behavior while you investigate.

eli_oncall: We can add a routing config override to inject a system prompt augmentation for acme-01 as a hotfix. I'll open a PR and target a 3h ETA. Global rollback of the model rollout is heavier (coord with release engineering).

product_lead: Prioritize tenant-level toggle. We should avoid global rollbacks if we can patch behavior per-customer. @maya_research please propose the minimal system augmentation text we can inject.

maya_research: Suggestion for augmentation:

"System: When responding, include brief courteous framing and a one-sentence closing. Aim for clarity but do not remove helpful steps."

sophie_support: I've opened INC-2026-112 and attached logs, maya's eval, and acme's repro. Will update once eli's PR is merged. Thanks everyone.

acme_corp_ops: Thanks — please keep us posted, we have a customer-facing incident.
